policy.name: owners read matched event inquiries
policy.using_expr:
((lead_type = 'event_inquiry'::text) AND (business_id IS NULL) AND (auth.uid() IS NOT NULL) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM businesses b
  WHERE ((b.owner_id = auth.uid()) AND (b.id = ANY (leads.assigned_vendor_ids))))))

finding18.statement: On the live-shaped baseline, OWN-A and OWN-B are both in assigned_vendor_ids for one marketplace lead and both SELECT the same stage and internal_notes. That is the known FXM-005 / #18 gap. Separate note bodies were stored as lead_messages because the table has no per-vendor note.
